Re-processings of the SAME real scan: soft = Gaussian in-plane smoothing sigma 1 voxel (3 mm, mimics a softer kernel); noisy = added Gaussian noise sigma 25 HU (mimics lower dose), seeded; thick = mean of slices z and z+1 (6 mm slices). bw = HU bin width.
